name: Michael Bennet

issue_poll.name: Marist Poll Colorado, Oct 3–6, 2022; Pew Research Center national survey, Oct 10–16, 2022
issue_poll.note: Ranks 1–6 from Marist's Colorado top-issue question (inflation 34%, preserving democracy 29%, abortion 16%, crime 7%, health care 6%, immigration 6%); 'preserving democracy' mapped to elections/voting. Ranks 7–10 filled from Pew's national 'very important' list (https://www.pewresearch.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/20/2022/10/PP_2022.10.20_midterms-economy_REPORT.pdf) for issues Marist did not offer.

issues.position: Permanently expand the child tax credit

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

votes.question: On the motion to commit with instructions

issues.note: Called the child tax credit his top policy priority in the 2022 race.

issues.position: Guarantee ballot access nationwide; change Senate rules to pass it
Pass federal law barring abortion restrictions (Women's Health Protection Act)

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.position: Fund civilian crisis responders (SMART Community Policing Act)
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on the SMART Community Policing Act this term.

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: Public option never received a floor vote.

issues.position: Legal status for DACA recipients; strengthen border security

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: No floor vote on DACA legal status this term.

issues.position: No specific position found; criticized design of Biden loan forgiveness
Keep the Inflation Reduction Act's climate and clean-energy measures
Universal background checks; assault weapons ban; raise purchase age to 21
issues.note: No recorded Senate floor vote on these measures this term.
No court-expansion bill or Supreme Court nomination reached the floor this term.

caveats: Issue list combines a Colorado poll (ranks 1–6) with Pew national data (ranks 7–10); no Colorado poll ranking all ten was found.
H.R.1 (roll call 372) not scored under the child tax credit: it raised the credit but not the 2021-style expansion he backed; scoring it would make issue 1 Mixed.
Elections rated on SAVE America Act votes; the ballot-access legislation and rules change he backed never got a floor vote.
Health care, energy and immigration ratings rest on votes that test only part of each stated position.
